title: Facebook Followup
content: Thanks for everyone who joined in to the Facebook Live stream, and stuck with oddly intermittent broadcast (we had an awesome connection, but it kept freezing and dumping us out.)Anyway, here's the 15 minute gouache demo. We'll go through all the comments, shares, and questions posted up until 9:00 tonight to choose winners for the prizes (Australian First Day cover, Dinotopia trading cards for best comment, and Department of Art patch for best share).-----Portraits in the WildDownload (66 minutes, 1080p HD widescreen MP4 video)Available at GumroadandSellfy.DVD (NTSC widescreen with slideshow)Available from Kunaki.comand fromAmazon(regular price)
